{if:SF.IsMythic}{c_mythic}{/if}Your {c_important}Darkness{/c} Skills {c_important}{u}Chill{/u}{/c} enemies for up to {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"|%|]{/c} and deal {if:SF.IsMythic}{c_number}{else}{c_random}{/if}[Affix_Value_1 * 100|%x|]{/c} increased damage to {c_important}{u}Frozen{/u}{/c} enemies and bosses.

Every {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c} times you damage enemies with {c_important}Darkness{/c} Skills, all Nearby enemies are Feared for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 2"|2|]{/c} seconds before {c_important}{u}Freezing{/u}{/c} for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 3"]{/c} more seconds.{if:SF.IsMythic}{/c_mythic}{/if}
